status_code_data.description: The HTTP 425 Too Early client error response status code indicates that the server was unwilling to risk processing a request that might be replayed to avoid potential replay attacks.

meme_data.description: I Am Speed is a memorable quote from the Pixar film Cars uttered by the character Lightning McQueen as a mantra to provide confidence during a race. A screencap from the film is often used as the punchline in an image macro series popularized on /r/dankmemes.
